Board question: Which business decision will this AI pilot support or automate?
Evidence to attach: Approved use-case brief success criteria and out-of-scope list
Green signal: Use case and exclusions are written and approved
Escalate or stop signal: Multiple use cases are bundled without priority
External claim boundary: Do not claim enterprise transformation from a narrow pilot

Board question: Who could be affected if outputs are wrong late or unavailable?
Evidence to attach: User groups journey map complaint log and human fallback owner
Green signal: Affected users and fallback paths are named
Escalate or stop signal: No owner for user impact or complaints
External claim boundary: Do not claim customer-safe production readiness without fallback evidence

Board question: What sensitive regulated or customer data touches the pilot?
Evidence to attach: Data inventory retention rule consent/legal review notes
Green signal: Data sources and restrictions are documented
External claim boundary: Do not claim compliance or privacy approval without qualified review

Board question: What evidence shows outputs are acceptable for the pilot decision?
Evidence to attach: Evaluation set regression results error taxonomy and monitoring threshold
Green signal: Pass/fail threshold and retest cadence exist
Escalate or stop signal: No repeatable eval or acceptance threshold
External claim boundary: Do not claim accuracy superiority from demos

Board question: When must humans review override or stop the workflow?
Evidence to attach: Override log escalation policy and role permissions
Green signal: Override triggers and permissions are clear
Escalate or stop signal: Human review relies on informal judgement
External claim boundary: Do not claim autonomous operation where human approval is required

Board question: Who can access prompts data tools actions and logs?
Evidence to attach: Access review export least-privilege exception list and incident route
Green signal: Access is reviewed and exceptions are time-boxed
Escalate or stop signal: Shared accounts or privileged access without review
External claim boundary: Do not claim secure-by-default without access evidence

Board question: What cost exposure appears if usage doubles or expands?
Evidence to attach: Unit-cost estimate budget threshold anomaly runbook and approval gate
Green signal: Cost limit and scale approval gate are documented
Escalate or stop signal: Pilot can scale spend without owner approval
External claim boundary: Do not claim ROI or savings without measured baseline and finance sign-off

Board question: Which vendor tool model cloud or integration could block production?
Evidence to attach: Vendor-risk notes SLA/support path exit plan and procurement owner
Green signal: Critical dependencies and fallback are visible
Escalate or stop signal: Key dependencies lack SLA exit or support owner
External claim boundary: Do not imply vendor endorsement partnership or certification

Board question: How can the pilot be paused restricted or reverted?
Evidence to attach: Rollback checklist feature flag/manual mode retest gate and communications owner
Green signal: Pause criteria and containment action are tested
Escalate or stop signal: No tested way to stop or contain the pilot
External claim boundary: Do not claim production-ready without rollback evidence

Board question: What decision is the board or steering group being asked to make?
Evidence to attach: One-page decision record open risks accepted risks date and signatures
Green signal: Decision options and accepted risks are explicit
Escalate or stop signal: Approval is inferred from meeting discussion
External claim boundary: Do not state approval unless the decision record exists
